composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Create a centered orchid mantis resting on a single ivory petal, seen from a shallow frontal angle. Its folded forelegs and broad petal-like legs form a compact almost symmetrical silhouette. Use pale blush, warm white, and a muted mauve shadow against a solid dark mulberry background. Keep the insect recognizable through its triangular head and slender body, but reduce the anatomy to a handful of flat curved shapes. One leg may extend slightly farther to break rigid symmetry. Avoid threatening posture, exaggerated eyes, and intricate wing veins. The pale silhouette should remain clear at avatar size, with the lone petal providing a quiet curved foundation.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
